Ships in the module root (`go env GOMODCACHE`/github.com/grow-codes-packages/__KEY__/go@vX/AGENTS.md). Use it
instead of reading the source. Docs: https://grow-codes-packages.github.io/__KEY__/ · Service: __DISPLAY__ ·
Categories: __CATEGORIES__. Package name: `__PKG__`. Needs Go >= 1.26 (`GOTOOLCHAIN=auto` on older images).

## Client

```go
import __PKG__ "github.com/grow-codes-packages/__KEY__/go"

client, err := __PKG__.NewClientFromEnv() // GROW___KEY_UPPER___* > vendor env > defaults
defer client.Close()
```

Errors are `*__PKG__.Error` with `Code`; use `errors.Is(err, __PKG__.ErrNotFound)` (`ErrConfig`, `ErrAuthentication`,
`ErrPermissionDenied`, `ErrConflict`, `ErrRateLimited`, `ErrValidation`, `ErrUnavailable`, `ErrTimeout`,
`ErrUnsupported`, `ErrCancelled`). Credentials are `Secret` (redacted in fmt/slog/JSON).

## Secrets: load the service configuration (one call)

```go
values, err := __PKG__.LoadConfig(ctx, __PKG__.LoadOptions{Required: []string{"DATABASE_URL"}, IntoEnv: true})
if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) } // NOT_FOUND names the missing keys
```

- `LoadConfig(ctx context.Context, opts LoadOptions) (map[string]string, error)`;
  `LoadOptions{Required []string; IntoEnv bool; KeepExisting bool; Path string; Env map[string]string; Connect SecretsConnector}`
  (`IntoEnv` → `os.Setenv`; set it, the zero value only returns the map).
- Reads the platform bootstrap `GROW_SECRETS_PROVIDER` (must be `__KEY__`), `GROW_SECRETS_ADDR`,
  `GROW_SECRETS_KV_MOUNT`, `GROW_SECRETS_PATH`, `GROW_SECRETS_AUTH=approle` + `GROW_SECRETS_ROLE_ID`/`_SECRET_ID`
  (AppRole login), then every key under `GROW_SECRETS_PATH` (never `GROW_SECRETS_*` into the env).
- No bootstrap (local dev) → checks `Required` against the environment only. `GROW_SECRETS_LOADED=1`
  (grow-secrets-exec) → same, returns the required keys.
- Also: `LoadConfigFrom(ctx, provider, opts)`, `ReadSecretsBootstrap(env)`, `SecretsPreloaded(env)`, `PackageKey`.
<!-- @sdk-kit:endif -->

## Logging: one call

```go
logger, shutdown, err := __PKG__.InitLogging(ctx, __PKG__.InitOptions{Service: "orders"}) // after LoadConfig
defer shutdown(context.Background())
http.ListenAndServe(":8080", __PKG__.RequestMiddleware(mux)) // X-Request-Id + "request completed"
logger.InfoContext(r.Context(), "created", "id", id)
```

- `InitLogging(ctx, InitOptions{Service, Level string; Stdout, DisableStdout, Ship, NoSetDefault bool; ...})
  (*slog.Logger, func(context.Context) error, error)`; installs `slog.Default`.
- Always JSON lines on stdout (`time`, `level`, `msg`, `service`, `environment`, `request_id`, `trace_id`,
  `span_id`, attributes, redacted). With `GROW_LOGGING_PROVIDER=__KEY__` it also ships through this package
  (config from `GROW___KEY_UPPER___*`), marks lines `log_shipped:"sdk"` and re-emits records the SDK could not
  export with `log_shipped:"sdk_failed"`. Never fails for a down logging service.
- `RequestMiddleware(next http.Handler) http.Handler`, `WithRequestID(ctx, id)`, `RequestIDFrom(ctx)`,
  `SendCanary(ctx, message, attrs) bool` (SDK only), `LoggingClient()`; adapters `NewSlogHandler(client, opts)`,
  subpackage `zapadapter`.
